text: 他这样做简直是画蛇添足。
translation: What he did was simply overcomplicating things.

expressions.literal: To draw a snake and add feet to it
expressions.meaning: To spoil something by adding unnecessary details or doing superfluous work.
expressions.origin: From 'Strategies of the Warring States'. A man finished drawing a snake first in a contest, but lost because he spent extra time adding feet.
expressions.equivalent: Gild the lily / Paint the lily
